Every file of the pinned tree's README, two victory indexes and certificates directory is in the scope and bound to its Git blob; under derived-only custody none is copied. No source program was executed.
license: No licence file in the pinned tree, and its README states no reuse terms. Derived-only custody under the known-best retention policy, as for the source's packets of issues 470, 573 and 593: no upstream byte is retained, every file is bound here by SHA-256 and at the pin by its Git blob, and no redistribution permission or licence determination is asserted. The tree names no credit or AI-assistance terms; issue #719 credits Mishapolk (Mikhail Polk; its first edit wrote Mykhailo Polkovskyi), lists the earlier finders its packings build on and discloses Gemini assistance.
